name: ebca
description: TypeScript packages for Event-Based Component Architecture.

scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:packages
scripts.build:all: bun run build:core && bun run build:packages && cd packages/gql-gateway && bun run build:nestjs
scripts.build:packages: cd packages/cli && bun run build && cd ../ws-gateway && bun run build && cd ../gql-gateway && bun run build && cd ../healthcheck && bun run build && cd ../rest-gateway && bun run build && cd ../analytics-sink && bun run build
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/ws-gateway && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/gql-gateway && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/healthcheck && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/rest-gateway && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @ebca/analytics-sink
